title: Sign-twisted tester acceptance probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a domain, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to signs making $r$ queries. For any sign-valued functions $\mathrm{phase},f:\Omega\to\{\pm1\}$, the acceptance probability of the tester with its transcript values multiplied by the phase at each queried point, when run on $f$, equals the acceptance probability of $T$ when run on the pointwise product $x\mapsto f(x)\,\mathrm{phase}(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to signs with $r$ query positions
